cohort: 184,422 women in the Netherlands who had a singleton, vertex birth of their first child after a gestation of at least 37 weeks between 2016-2018
finding: Practice variation in labor induction is high in Dutch maternity care networks, with limited association with maternal outcomes and no association with perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Networks with low induction rates had lower unplanned caesarean section rates compared to networks with moderate rates.
